svg.text: From meeting promises to verified delivery
Local-first work intelligence. It began as a meeting recorder and became the system that tracks whether promised
work actually got done: it records meetings, pulls out actions and decisions, then watches six work tools for proof
Two-track capture with no meeting bot;
Matches promises to PRs, to-dos, Slack
Agendas, follow-ups and a cited monthly
Emails, calendar events, issues and to-
dos wait for approval. Nothing is sent
